d: A new mining season begins, and the competition is already heating up! Parker Schnabel reunites his crew and gets Big Red ready for action, while a new deal on mining ground could help him break free from Tony Beets. Meanwhile, Todd Hoffman is determined to hit an ambitious 5,000-ounce gold target and puts 100 ounces on the line in a wager against Parker. But with his son Hunter stepping up to take charge of Monster Red, Todd's operation faces a new test of its own. And as Tony Beets sets out to revive his second massive dredge, the race for gold is officially on. Who will get the early lead?
